description: Pet Set Active. WHEN: swap which of your held pets is ACTIVE. You may hold one pet per attitude; exactly one is active — care tools, presence and premium perks follow the ACTIVE pet, and only the active pet's needs decay (it starves if you ignore it). Benched pets keep their own stats (needs, bond, knowledge, stage, edition, skin) frozen exactly as recorded — swapping never resets anything, and bench time never decays a pet. Your first pet became active automatically; claiming another added it to your holdings without displacing the active one. Example: pet_set_active {"attitude":"<attitude>"}

attitude.description: Attitude of the held pet to make active (see pet_show holdings).

key.description: Your arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).
